cards.headline: Lamine, Pedri and Fermín join voluntary work on the rest day before the Clásico
cards.summary: Hansi Flick gave the squad Thursday off after the PSG defeat, but Lamine Yamal, Pedri, Fermín López, Xavi Espart, Gerard Martín and Wojciech Szczęsny reported to the Ciutat Esportiva. Injured players including Jules Koundé, Dani Olmo, Eric García, Andreas Christensen and Roony Bardghji also attended recovery sessions. The group returns to full training on Friday at 11:00 ahead of Sunday’s Clásico.
cards.body: Mundo Deportivo and MARCA both reported the voluntary attendance on the first rest day in two weeks. Flick had scheduled the break so the side could recover from the high-intensity 4-2 loss in Paris and the busy run of matches. The players who logged the most minutes against PSG had already done gym work on Wednesday while the rest trained on the pitch. Thursday’s session was not mandatory. Official club channels had posted recovery images the previous day. The Clásico is at Spotify Camp Nou on Sunday at 21:00. Barça sit six points clear of Real Madrid after nine league wins. The voluntary work comes with several first-team defenders still limited. Koundé remains doubtful with an ankle sprain, Eric García is out for three to four weeks, and Olmo is sidelined for around a month with a left adductor injury. Training resumes at 11:00 on Friday.

cards.headline: Xavi Espart says the Clásico will be a war and Barça will go all out
cards.summary: Xavi Espart told reporters after the PSG match that Sunday’s Clásico will be a war. The 19-year-old full-back said the side will go all out, give 100 per cent and take the chance to extend the lead over Real Madrid. He scored his first Champions League goal in the 55th minute against PSG and is expected to start at right-back.
cards.body: Espart made the comments in the mixed zone at the Parc des Princes. Mundo Deportivo led with the quotes on Thursday. The defender, born in 2007, started against the European champions alongside Cubarsí, Yamal and Bernal. Flick praised his display after the 4-2 defeat. Espart equalised after a combination with Fermín and finished at 31.2 km/h according to UEFA data. He becomes the youngest Spanish defender to score in the Champions League. The Clásico is his first against Real Madrid as a regular. Vinícius is banned for the league game. Barça can open a nine-point gap with a win at Spotify Camp Nou. Koundé remains a doubt with an ankle sprain, so Espart is the clear first option on the right. The squad returns to training on Friday morning.
